description: Renewable Energy Generation Capacity: 2006 - 2017 is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. This data set estimates the installed capacity for renewable energy generation in Maryland, in megawatts (MW). Coverage: Maryland. The portal files it under the category Energy and Environment. Its tags are electricity, solar, maryland energy administration, mea, photovoltaic. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Maryland Energy Administration. The portal shows 2018-05-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
